title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
马寻就这么住在了皇宫里，和李贞成为了邻居。一个是皇帝的小舅子，一个是皇帝的姐夫，看着也非常合适。大清早的，李贞牵着李景隆来了，“小弟，起来了吗？”马寻匆匆从屋里走出来，说道，“姐夫，起来了。”李景隆立刻奶声奶气喊人，“舅爷爷。”别管李景隆是不是大明第一代战神，白白胖胖的小娃娃讨人喜欢，“过来，舅爷爷给你钱买果子吃。”李贞笑着抱怨说道，“小弟，你才刚到京城，陛下才赏了你些财物以安身，你给了孩子像什么话！”马寻就笑着说道，“我是长辈，自然喜欢小的。我现在吃穿不愁，要那些浮财做什么？”说着这些，马寻将一个玉佩塞给李景隆，“拿着，咱家景隆以后肯定是个君子！”看到孙儿求助的看了过来，李贞说道，“长者赐不敢辞。收下吧。”李景隆开开心心的收下玉佩，而马寻也不得不感慨李贞不愧是宗室模范。李贞招了招手说道，“去俺那用饭。小弟，俺岁数大、说几句不中听的。业精于勤荒于嬉，小弟一身好武艺不能荒废了。”马寻连忙说道，“姐夫教训的是，这几天我是有些懒散了。”“歇歇也好，寻常人还有些休息时候。”李贞就说道，“小弟，现在住着还习惯？”马寻想了想，还是实话实说，“院子大自然舒服，就是不习惯有人伺候。我前天起夜，看到一小丫头坐垫子上打瞌睡守着夜，哪能受得了。”李贞理解马寻的感受，都是穷苦过来的人，自然一时间不适应有人伺候。李贞就劝道，“小弟如果不习惯有人在夜里也守着，就让他们在隔壁小屋歇着。你跟前要是没人伺候，陛下肯定不高兴。”马寻也能理解，不过还是说道，“我这么年轻力壮的，用不着这么多人伺候。穿衣都有人帮，想想都不自在。”李景隆就奶声奶气的说道，“舅爷爷，我不穿衣，爷爷给我穿衣。”“你是小孩，自然帮你穿衣。”马寻就笑着开口，“等你长大了，那就自己穿衣。”李景隆又奶声奶气说道，“舅爷爷，我喜欢旺财。”

马寻扭头看向院子，说道，“你一会儿就去折腾那蠢驴，一天天的除了吃就是瞎叫唤，都长胖了。”李贞的早饭还是比较简单，没有什么山珍海味，哪怕现在身份尊贵了，他还是保持着一些老农民的本色。菜肯定是要吃完，就算是李景隆也不能在饭碗里留下剩饭。马寻刚吃饱，一个侍卫急匆匆而来，“见过侯爷、国舅，陛下召国舅大本堂读书。”来了，陪太子读书的工作正式开始了。李贞立刻笑着说道，“小弟去进学，俺帮你照料旺财。”愁眉苦脸的马寻就跟着侍卫前往大本堂，还没落座就显得十分尴尬了。太子朱标领头，七个皇子向他行礼、叫舅舅。朱元璋现在十个儿子，不过岁数太小的就没有来读书。这还只是开始，老朱年近三十才有第一个儿子，等到六十多依然能生，这就是超长待机、厚积薄发。宋濂等大学士、博士等人终于见到了传说中的马国舅，又高又黑又瘦，还有着一头短发，看着就像是刚还俗没多久。宋濂也仔细的考校了一下，这位国舅爷识字、算是读过书，但是也仅此而已，谈不上什么学问。其他的皇子们在读书，马寻就安静的听着，时常有些昏昏欲睡。不过强撑着，时常拿几本史书自己看一看打发时间。不好好学习，也不破坏课堂秩序。要是外甥们当中有人不好好学，一下课他就和朱标联手教育。他唱红脸、朱标唱白脸，将朱棣等人吓唬的够呛。朱元璋忙完一天的政事回到了乾清宫，问道，“小弟这些天也不过来看看咱们？”马秀英有些不高兴的说道，“他一个人习惯了，太自强自立。我听说了，他连让人伺候都不习惯。”朱元璋嘿嘿一笑，说道，“得了富贵，还是不习惯。随便他，别强压着他当贵人，他怎么舒服怎么来。”马秀英点头说道，“俺自然也明白这个道理，就让他院子里的人用不着那么殷勤。”在默默看奏章的朱标就说道，“也不能不管，舅舅是宽厚之人，不以小事责罚人。但是如果没有规矩，手底下的人就没了本分。”朱元璋和马秀英都非常满意朱标的见解，马寻可以对手底下的人宽松一些。但是那些人也不能因此蹬鼻子上脸、没有规矩，该管还是要管。朱元璋随即问道，“你舅舅读书读的怎么样？”“强撑着没有打瞌睡，就自己在那看书。”朱标笑着说道，“舅舅和娘一样喜欢看史书，时常看不明白就私下和博士探讨。”

Ma Xun lived in the palace and became neighbors with Li Zhen.One is the emperor's brother-in-law, and the other is the emperor's brother-in-law, which looks very suitable.Early in the morning, Li Zhen came with Li Jinglong in hand, "Brother, are you up?" Ma Xun hurriedly walked out of the house and said, "Brother-in-law, you're up." Li Jinglong immediately called out in a sweet voice, "Uncle, grandpa." Don't worry about whether Li Jinglong isHe is the first generation God of War in the Ming Dynasty. His chubby little baby is cute and lovable. "Come here, uncle and grandpa will give you money to buy fruits to eat." Li Zhen complained with a smile, "Little brother, you have just arrived in the capital, and His Majesty has just rewarded you with some property to settle down. You can give it to me."What are you talking about if you have a child?" Ma Xun said with a smile, "I am an elder, so I naturally like the younger ones.I don't have to worry about food and clothing now.What do I want with that extravagance?" After saying this, Ma Xun handed a jade pendant to Li Jinglong, "Here, our family is well-off.Long will definitely be a gentleman in the future!" Seeing his grandson looking over for help, Li Zhen said, "I dare not refuse the gift." Li Jinglong happily accepted the jade pendant, and Ma Xun couldn't help but feel that Li Zhen was indeed a model for the clan.Li Zhen waved her hand and said, "Go to my place for dinner. Little brother, I'm old, and I can't say a few words that are pleasant to the ears. Industry is better than hard work, and play is neglected. My good martial arts cannot be wasted." Ma Xun said quickly, "My brother-in-law taught me that I have been a little lazy these days." "It's good to take a break, ordinary people still have some time to rest." Li Zhen said, ""Brother, are you still used to living there now?"Ma Xun thought for a moment, then told the truth, "The courtyard is naturally comfortable, but I'm not used to being waited on. I woke up the night before and saw a little girl dozing on a cushion and watching the night. How could I bear it?"Li Zhen understood Ma Xun's feelings. They were all poor people, so naturally they were not used to being served.Li Zhen advised, "If I'm not used to having people watching over me at night, let them rest in the hut next door. Your Majesty will definitely not be happy if there's no one waiting in front of you." Ma Xun could understand, but still said, "I'm so young and strong, so I don't need so many people to help me. I have someone to help me with my dressing, I think."I don't feel comfortable thinking about it."Li Jinglong said in a sweet voice, "Uncle, I don't have to dress, so grandpa will dress me.""You are a child, so I will help you get dressed."Ma Xun said with a smile, "When you grow up, you can dress yourself.""Uncle, I like to make money."

Ma Xun turned to look at the yard and said, "You're going to torment that stupid donkey in a moment. He only eats and barks and gets fat every day." Li Zhen's breakfast is still relatively simple, without any delicacies. Even though he has a distinguished status now, he still maintains the true qualities of an old farmer.The food must be finished, even Li Jinglong cannot leave any leftovers in the rice bowl.As soon as Ma Xun had finished eating, a guard hurriedly came over and said, "I have met the Marquis and Uncle Guo. Your Majesty summoned Uncle Guo to study in the main hall." After arriving, the work of studying with the prince officially began.Li Zhen immediately said with a smile, "My little brother, go to school, and I will help you take care of your wealth." Ma Xun, with a frown on his face, followed the guards to the main hall, looking very embarrassed before he even sat down.Prince Zhu Biao took the lead, and the seven princes saluted him and called him uncle.Zhu Yuanzhang now has ten sons, but they are too young to study.This is just the beginning. Lao Zhu didn't have his first son until he was nearly 30 years old, and he can still give birth to a child when he is over 60. This is a long wait and a lot of accumulation.Song Lian and other bachelors and doctors finally met the legendary Uncle Ma Guo. He was tall, dark, thin, and had short hair. He looked like he had just returned to secular life.Song Lian also took a careful examination and found that the uncle was literate and had read books, but that was all, and there was no knowledge at all.The other princes were reading, and Ma Xun listened quietly, often feeling drowsy.But I managed to hold on, and often took a few history books to read by myself to pass the time.Do not study hard and do not disrupt class order.If any of the nephews didn't study hard, he would work with Zhu Biao to teach him after class.He played the red face, while Zhu Biao played the white face, scaring Zhu Di and others to death.Zhu Yuanzhang returned to the Qianqing Palace after a busy day of political affairs and asked, "Brother, you haven't come to see us these days?" Ma Xiuying said a little unhappy, "He is used to being alone, and he is too self-reliant. I heard that he is not even used to being served." Zhu Yuanzhang chuckled and said, "I am still not used to being rich. Let him be free, don't force him to be a noble, he can do whatever he feels comfortable with."Ma Xiuying nodded and said, "Of course I also understand this truth, so that the people in his yard don't need to be so attentive." Zhu Biao, who was reading the memorial silently, said, "We can't ignore it. My uncle is a generous person and does not punish people for small things. But if there are no rules, the people under him will lose their duties." Zhu Yuanzhang and Ma Xiuying were very satisfied with Zhu Biao's opinion, and Ma Xun could be more lenient with the people under him.But those people can't get into trouble because of this, and they have no rules. They should still be controlled when they should be.Zhu Yuanzhang immediately asked, "How is your uncle's reading?" "I managed not to doze off, so I just read there by myself." Zhu Biao said with a smile, "My uncle likes to read history books as much as my mother. I often discuss it with the doctor in private if I can't understand it."
